preconditions.description: The dimensions of the chessboard are between 3 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a_x, a_y, b_x, b_y, c_x, c_y <= n
preconditions.description: The coordinates of the queen, king, and target are within the bounds of the chessboard.
The king is not on the same square as the queen.
The target is not the same square as the queen.
The target is not the same square as the king.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' or 'NO', indicating whether Bob can reach the target without getting in check.
